why: A site that answers an error page with HTTP 200 (a soft 404) produced passages: ElCom's sitemap lists /de/404 and /de/500, both return 200, and both were admitted as 'Ein Fehler ist aufgetreten' (task 683 finding 2). The framework (cytir.sources.run_family) excludes a unit whose extracted text is short AND says, in its title or at its head, that the page is an error page. Length is the guard against a long page that merely discusses errors. Excluded, never deleted: the bytes stay sealed in L0 and the unit ends `excluded(soft_404:<signal>)`.
